questions.stem: Which property controls the changes in cost and resource plans with respect to the change in the start date of a demand or project?

options.text: ‘Change Resource Plan, Cost Plan and Benefit Plan Start Date with Demand or Project Start Date Change’.
‘Enable altering of planned date for task in WIP/Closed’.
‘Calculate ROI percentage based on a project's estimated cost and its net value’.

questions.explanation: The property 'Change Resource Plan, Cost Plan and Benefit Plan Start Date with Demand or Project Start Date Change' directly controls whether cost plans, resource plans, and benefit plans shift when the demand or project start date changes. The other properties handle ROI calculation, start date rollup from tasks, or project copy attributes respectively.

questions.stem: Which statement defines the Project Workspace?

options.text: A central location to view of all projects in a portfolio to prioritize work
A central location for creating and managing projects
A central location for viewing and assessing business demands
A central location transform the navigation of lists and forms into an interactive graphical experience

questions.explanation: Project Workspace is a central location for creating and managing projects. It provides project managers with tools to plan, track, and monitor projects. Option A describes portfolio-level views, C describes the Demand Workbench for assessing demands, and D describes a generic workspace/dashboard concept rather than Project Workspace specifically.

questions.stem: If a sub-project and parent project have different project currencies, this property should be set to true for cost roll-ups.
questions.explanation: The property com.snc.project.multicurrency.rollup_if_different must be set to true to enable cost rollups when a sub-project and parent project use different currencies. Without this, multi-currency cost data will not aggregate correctly. The other properties handle start date rollup, ROI calculation, and copying additional attributes.

questions.stem: When can a user choose from multiple rate types for their work, while logging a time card?

options.text: Only if this capability is enabled in the Project Record
Only one (1) rate type can apply
Only if the capability is enabled in the Time Sheet Policies
Only if the capability is enabled in the Project Preferences

questions.explanation: Multiple rate types for time card logging are controlled through Time Sheet Policies. When this capability is enabled in the Time Sheet Policies, users can choose from multiple rate types when logging time. It is not controlled at the project record level or project preferences — it is specifically a time sheet policy configuration.

questions.stem: If Scenario Planning for PPM is installed, a portfolio manager can access the Portfolio Planning Workbench by navigating to which of the following? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The Portfolio Planning Workbench can be accessed via two paths: the Portfolio Planning Workbench module (direct navigation) and the Portfolio Planning related link on a portfolio record. The Project module and Program Workbench provide access to their own respective views, not the Portfolio Planning Workbench.

questions.stem: What is the first step in the process when configuring Portfolio Planning to work with ServiceNow® Project Portfolio Management?
questions.explanation: The first step when configuring Portfolio Planning with PPM is to generate default mapping configurations. This creates the table maps (table, field, and choice maps) for projects and demands. Navigate to Portfolio Planning > Integrations > ServiceNow Internal and click Generate Default Mapping Configurations. The alignment integration already exists as a pre-built internal integration.

questions.stem: Which role should be assigned to a user so they can read and retrieve data from any table of the Release Management application to generate reports?
questions.explanation: The release_user role provides read access to Release Management application tables, enabling a user to retrieve data and generate reports. The release_admin role gives full administrative access beyond what is needed for reporting. Project manager and business stakeholder roles do not have specific Release Management table access.

questions.stem: Which plugin activates the Ideas module to gather and evaluate ideas efficiently, and quickly identify ideas for implementation?
questions.explanation: The Ideation with PPM plugin activates the Ideas module for gathering and evaluating ideas efficiently. Innovation Management enables organizations to quickly identify ideas with greatest implementation potential. Agile Development 2.0, Resource Management, and Test Management 2.0 serve entirely different purposes.

questions.stem: In order to map custom fields from Microsoft Project to ServiceNow when importing a project, you must first:

options.text: Export the project to XML format
Create custom fields in your ServiceNow instance

questions.explanation: Before mapping custom fields from Microsoft Project to ServiceNow during import, you must first create the corresponding custom fields in your ServiceNow instance. The target fields must exist before the mapping can be configured. Exporting to XML, configuring the form, or importing the project are later steps in the process.

questions.stem: Can an it_project_manager convert a task to a milestone?

options.text: No, this can only be done by a system admin.
Yes, by right-clicking on the task in the Planning Console.
No, the PPS admin role is also required.
Yes, if the task is assigned to the project manager.

questions.explanation: An it_project_manager can convert a task to a milestone by right-clicking on the task in the Planning Console and selecting the conversion option. This does not require system admin or PPS admin roles. The Planning Console provides context menu actions for task management including milestone conversion.

questions.stem: Use this table to configure the parameters displayed on a project card on the My Projects Space page of the Project Workspace.
questions.explanation: The pm_home_page_config table is used to configure the parameters displayed on project cards on the My Projects Space page of Project Workspace. This table controls which fields and metrics appear on the card view. pm_toplevel_project is for projects, project_template_config is for templates, and pm_project is the base project table.

questions.stem: As a demand manager, you can view an artifact from a demand. What artifacts are part of a demand?
questions.explanation: Artifacts that are part of a demand include Decisions, Risks, and Requirements. These are RIDAC-type items and requirements that exist on the demand record as related lists. Projects, Defects, and Enhancements are artifacts created FROM a demand (output), not artifacts that are part of it. Incidents, Problems, and Changes are ITSM records.

questions.stem: When creating a project from demand, what related records are moved and copied upon Project Creation?
questions.explanation: When creating a project from a demand, the Resource Plan and Cost Plan are the related records that are moved and copied to the new project. This ensures the financial and resource planning data carries over to the project. Assessments, change requests, and ideas/demands themselves are not moved in this process.

questions.stem: If an it_project_manager does not want to equally distribute hours across the resource plan time frame, what allocation spread should be used?
questions.explanation: Front Load allocation spread distributes more hours toward the beginning of the resource plan time frame, resulting in an unequal distribution. This is useful when heavier effort is needed early in a project. Back Load places more hours at the end, Even distributes equally, and 'Any' is not a standard allocation spread option.

questions.stem: If the ‘Move project for WIP projects’ property is enabled, project tasks associated with the project are also moved, except for tasks in which of the following states? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: When the 'Move project for WIP projects' property is enabled, project tasks in Work in Progress and Closed states are NOT moved. Tasks actively being worked on (WIP) should not be disrupted, and completed (Closed) tasks have no need to move. Tasks in Pending and Open states can still be relocated.

questions.stem: Depending on the execution type selected for a particular project, one of these dashboards will also be available:
questions.explanation: Depending on the execution type selected for a project, the Project Summary - Waterfall Dashboard becomes available when the Waterfall execution type is selected. This dashboard provides waterfall-specific metrics such as planned vs actual progress, milestones, and critical path analysis. Other dashboards listed serve different purposes.

questions.stem: The Project management application supports two types of external dependencies. What are they? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The Project Management application supports two types of external dependencies: Hard Dependency (blocks task progress until the external dependency is resolved) and Soft Dependency (informational only, does not block progress). Change, Task, and Milestone dependencies are internal project relationships, not external dependency types.

questions.stem: The combination of the user and the assigned portfolio must be unique when adding a user to which registry?
questions.explanation: The Stakeholder Registry requires the combination of user and assigned portfolio to be unique. Each stakeholder entry links a specific user to a specific portfolio, ensuring there are no duplicate stakeholder assignments. Application Registry, UX Page Registry, and Event Registry serve different purposes and do not have this constraint.

questions.stem: Where do you define ‘Roles’ requested via resource plans?

options.text: No need to define it differently, they are same as system roles.

questions.explanation: Roles requested via resource plans are defined as Resource Roles under the Resource Management module. These are distinct from system security roles — they represent project/work roles like Developer, Tester, or Architect that are used for resource planning and assignment. They are configured specifically for resource management purposes.

questions.stem: Where is planned cost calculated from when requesting resources from a group and when resource role is specified?

options.text: The hourly rate of the specified role.

questions.explanation: When requesting resources from a group with a resource role specified, the planned cost is calculated from the hourly rate of the specified role. The role's rate determines the expected cost. Task rate cards and CI rate cards are used for different cost calculations, and distribution costs apply to bulk cost allocation.

questions.stem: Which is the minimum role that has access to the Project Administration > Settings > Preferences-Project module?
questions.explanation: The it_pps_admin role is the minimum role required to access Project Administration > Settings > Preferences-Project. This administrative module controls project-level preferences and properties. The it_project_manager and it_program_manager roles do not have access to these administrative settings.

questions.stem: What is a data copy of the current project's task, schedule, or structure that can be used for comparison reporting later?
questions.explanation: A baseline is a data copy (snapshot) of the current project's tasks, schedule, and structure at a specific point in time. It preserves the project plan state for comparison reporting later, allowing project managers to track deviations from the original plan. Commitment, accrual, and forecast are financial terms, not project plan snapshots.

questions.stem: If a lens has four entities, which entity within the lens structure would not have a parent reference?
questions.explanation: In a lens structure with four entities, the top-level entity has no parent reference because it sits at the highest level of the hierarchy. All other entities (second-level, third-level, bottom) reference a parent entity above them. The top-level entity is the root of the lens hierarchy.

questions.stem: Which role can configure the parameters of the demand workbench that is provided with the base system?
questions.explanation: The it_pps_admin role is required to configure the parameters of the demand workbench provided with the base system. Navigate to Project Administration > Settings > Workbench Config - Demand to access the configuration. Bubble charts and other workbench parameters are configured with this admin role.

questions.stem: What are the default project template configuration records available in the Template Config module? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The default project template configuration records in the Template Config module are: Project template (for template definitions), Project (for project-level configurations), and Project task (for task-level configurations). Project subtask and Task are not default template configuration records.

questions.stem: What is the default table that stores the idea categories that a user can select from when submitting an idea?
questions.explanation: The im_category table stores idea categories that users can select when submitting an idea in Innovation Management. This table is specific to the Ideas module. im_idea_core is the idea table itself, im_module stores idea module configurations, and dmn_demand is the demand table.

questions.stem: A user's availability is calculated as:

options.text: Allocated hours divided by the total capacity
Sum of allocated and confirmed hours, divided by the total capacity

questions.explanation: A user's availability is calculated as Capacity minus Allocation — the total time available after all soft and hard allocations are subtracted from total capacity. This formula shows how much bandwidth a resource has remaining. The other options describe utilization metrics rather than availability.

questions.stem: The Business Unit field on a Project or Demand form displays values from a specific table. What type of field is this?
questions.explanation: The Business Unit field on a Project or Demand form is a Reference field. It references the cmn_department table (or similar organizational table) to display business unit values. Reference fields create a relationship to another table and display values from that table via a lookup, distinguishing them from List fields (multi-select), Conditions (query builder), and Journal fields (activity/work notes).

questions.stem: The project property to update actual effort from time card is controlled at what level?
questions.explanation: The property to update actual effort from time card is controlled at the Application Level (Global). This is a system-wide property (com.snc.project.update_actual_effort_from_time_card) that applies globally across all projects, not at the individual project, portfolio, or program level. It determines whether time card entries automatically update task actual effort.

questions.stem: What minimum role is required to assign a time sheet policy to a user?

options.text: It is not possible to assign a time sheet policy to a user.

questions.explanation: The timecard_admin role is the minimum role required to assign a time sheet policy to a user. Time sheet policies control time card behavior such as rate types, approval rules, and submission periods. The ppm_admin and it_project_manager roles do not manage time sheet policy assignments.

questions.stem: What does the project status report allow project managers to do? (Choose two.)

options.text: Show historical trend of project KPI's

questions.explanation: The project status report allows project managers to: (B) show historical trend of project KPIs, providing visibility into how key metrics evolve over time, and (C) print the report as a PDF attachment for sharing with stakeholders. The project Gantt chart (A) and WBS view (D) are available in the planning console, not through the status report feature.

questions.stem: What is a resource event?

options.text: A block of time that a resource spends on a task.
An event scheduled by a project manager.

questions.explanation: A resource event is a block of time that a resource spends on a task. It represents the actual time allocation for task execution within resource management. Resource events are used to track when and how long a resource works on assigned tasks. External events and non-scheduled activities are separate concepts.

questions.stem: What is the demand workbench used for? (Choose two.)

options.text: Comparing and prioritizing demands against other demands

questions.explanation: The demand workbench is used for approving demands and for comparing and prioritizing demands against other demands. It provides bubble chart visualizations to help decision makers compare demands based on metrics like risk, ROI, and cost. Approving ideas is done in Innovation Management, and comparing demands with portfolios is not a primary workbench function.

questions.stem: If a user creates a new demand from the demand workbench, what state will the system save the record in?
questions.explanation: When a user creates a new demand from the demand workbench, the system saves the record in draft state. This allows the user to add details before formally submitting the demand for assessment. The demand can later be promoted through the lifecycle: draft, submitted, screening, qualified, approved.

questions.stem: What is the formula for Committed Utilization?
questions.explanation: Committed Utilization is calculated as Allocated Hours divided by Capacity. This measures the percentage of resource capacity that has been allocated (soft bookings). Forecasted Utilization, by contrast, uses (Allocated + Confirmed Hours)/Capacity. The distinction is that Committed only counts planned allocations, not yet-confirmed time.

questions.stem: The RIDAC workflow can be modified by using which recommended feature?
questions.explanation: Flow Designer is the recommended feature for modifying the RIDAC workflow in ServiceNow. Flow Designer provides a modern, no-code approach to building and modifying workflows. While Workflow Editor was the legacy option, ServiceNow recommends Flow Designer for workflow modifications in current releases.

questions.stem: Which stage of the Now Create methodology includes Transition, Mobilize, Prepare and Conduct?
questions.explanation: The Transition stage of the Now Create methodology includes the phases Transition, Mobilize, Prepare, and Conduct. This stage focuses on transitioning the solution from development to production, including mobilizing the team, preparing for go-live, and conducting the actual transition activities.

questions.stem: Which artifacts can be linked to either a program, a portfolio, both, or neither? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Demands and Projects can be linked to either a program, a portfolio, both, or neither. Demands flow through the lifecycle and can be associated with programs for grouping or portfolios for strategic alignment. Projects similarly can belong to programs and portfolios. Stories (B) and Test cases (D) are agile/testing artifacts at a lower level, and Operational plans (E) have different association rules.

questions.stem: Which role is needed to group related projects and demands?
questions.explanation: The it_program_manager role is needed to group related projects and demands. Programs serve as containers that group related projects and demands together for coordinated management. The program manager role (it_program_manager) has the authority to create programs and link projects and demands to them. Project users and managers work within individual projects, and demand managers manage demands individually.

questions.stem: Using the Request type field on a resource plan, which options can be used to request a resource? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The Request type field on a resource plan supports three options for requesting resources: Person Days, Hours, and FTE (Full Time Equivalent). These correspond to the Effort Type options on the resource assignment form. Day and Month are not valid request type options.

questions.stem: What role can configure the default columns in the project planning console? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The admin and it_pps_admin roles can configure the default columns in the project planning console. The admin role has broad system configuration capabilities, while it_pps_admin is the PPM-specific administration role with authority over planning console configuration. Project managers (C) use the console but can't change its default column configuration, and it_console_admin is not a standard SPM role.

questions.stem: A checklist item record provides a name and what other element?
questions.explanation: A checklist item record provides a name and a Complete field (checkbox). The Complete field indicates whether the checklist item has been finished. This simple structure allows quick tracking of task completion. Status fields, percent complete, and short description fields are not part of the checklist item schema.

questions.stem: Which related lists should primarily be used to capture financial data in a project? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Cost Plans and Monetary Benefit Plans are the related lists primarily used to capture financial data in a project. Cost Plans track planned and actual expenditures (resource costs, fixed costs, software costs), while Monetary Benefit Plans capture the expected financial returns and benefits. Programs (A) are organizational containers, and Risks (D) are for risk management, not financial tracking.

questions.stem: Which demand category would a demand manager select, if they need to create an enhancement?
questions.explanation: A demand manager would select the Strategic demand category to create an enhancement. Strategic demands represent new capabilities, improvements, and enhancements that align with organizational strategy. Defect (A) is for bug fixes, Operational (B) is for BAU/routine needs, and Change (C) relates to change requests for existing systems rather than new enhancement initiatives.

questions.stem: In which table can you find cost information for a specific fiscal period?
questions.explanation: The cost_plan_breakdown table stores cost information broken down by specific fiscal periods. Each record in this table represents a planned or actual cost amount for a particular period within a cost plan. The expense_line table stores individual expense records, pm_project stores project data, and cost_plan stores the overall plan.

questions.stem: When copying a source project to a target project, what fields are copied by default? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: When copying a source project to a target project, the default fields copied include: Planned dates (start/end), Short description, and Duration fields. The Number field is auto-generated for the new project and is never copied. The State field is reset to the initial state rather than being copied from the source.

questions.stem: Which of the following can be used to calculate planned cost when creating a resource plan? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Default rate and Rate card can be used to calculate planned cost when creating a resource plan. The default rate provides a baseline hourly/daily cost for resources, while rate cards offer more granular, criteria-driven rates based on factors like role, skill level, or location. Together they enable accurate cost projections. Demand rate (B) and Project rate (C) are not standard rate sources for resource plan cost calculation.

questions.stem: On the demand form, what does the Discount Rate impact?
questions.explanation: The Discount Rate on the demand form impacts the Net Present Value (NPV) calculation. NPV uses the discount rate to convert future cash flows into present-day values, accounting for the time value of money. A higher discount rate reduces NPV. Internal Rate of Return (A) is calculated independently, Financial Benefit (B) is a raw value, and ROI (D) is a ratio not directly affected by discount rate input.

questions.stem: The color band at the top of the project card in Project Workspace displays what project attribute?
questions.explanation: The color band at the top of the project card in Project Workspace displays the project Status (health indicator). Green indicates on-track, yellow indicates at-risk, and red indicates off-track. This provides a visual overview of project health. State represents the lifecycle stage (Open, WIP, Closed), not the color-coded health band.

questions.stem: To set up a group for selection in a resource plan, the group record needs to include which role?
questions.explanation: To set up a group for selection in a resource plan, the group record needs to include the pps_resource role. This role designates that members of the group are available as resources for project planning purposes. Without the pps_resource role on the group, it won't appear as a selectable option when creating resource allocations in the resource plan.

questions.stem: Demand assessments are triggered as soon as the demand enters what state?
questions.explanation: Demand assessments are triggered as soon as the demand enters the Screening state. During screening, stakeholders receive assessment surveys to evaluate the demand across configured metrics like risk and strategic alignment. This occurs before the demand is qualified or approved in the lifecycle.

questions.stem: What information are users required to enter on a cost plan for a demand?
questions.explanation: Users are required to enter the Cost type when creating a cost plan for a demand. Cost type categorizes the expense (e.g., labor, hardware, software, consulting) and is a mandatory field that determines how the cost is classified and tracked. Discount Rate (A) has a default value, Functional currency (C) is typically inherited from system settings, and Total planned cost (D) is calculated from individual cost entries.

questions.stem: Users with what role can be considered for resource planning?
questions.explanation: Users with the it_project_user role can be considered for resource planning. This role enables users to participate in projects and makes them available as selectable resources in resource plans. The it_pps_user (A) is a broader PPM role, pps_resource (B) is a role for groups, and it_user (D) is too generic — it_project_user specifically qualifies individuals for project resource allocation.

questions.stem: Idea [im_idea_core] is directly extended from which table?

options.text: It is not extended from any table

questions.explanation: The Idea table [im_idea_core] is directly extended from the Task [task] table. This inheritance gives ideas all the standard task fields (number, state, assignment group, etc.) plus idea-specific fields. This is consistent with ServiceNow's pattern of extending the task table for various work types.

questions.stem: A project expense line is cost associated with a specific source, except for:
questions.explanation: A project expense line is cost associated with specific sources except for Program. Expense lines can be sourced from Resources (labor costs), Software (license costs), and Fixed Assets (capital equipment). Programs are higher-level containers that aggregate project costs but are not themselves a direct source of individual expense line items within a project.

questions.stem: A program is a container for the following except for:
questions.explanation: A program is a container for program tasks, issues, and cost plans, but NOT for Portfolios. Portfolios are at a higher organizational level and contain programs (not the other way around). The hierarchy is: Portfolio → Program → Project. Programs aggregate related projects and their associated tasks, issues, risks, and financial plans, but they sit within portfolios, not above them.

questions.stem: How many WBS levels can be shown on the planning console?
questions.explanation: The planning console can show WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) levels with no fixed limit. The console supports hierarchical task structures and displays all configured levels of the work breakdown, allowing project managers to drill into nested tasks at any depth. This flexibility accommodates projects of varying complexity without artificial constraints on organizational depth.

questions.stem: Is resource capacity derived from FTE or schedules?
questions.explanation: Resource capacity is derived from both FTE values and schedules. A user's schedule defines their working hours, while FTE defines what fraction of full-time they work. Both factors are combined to calculate the actual capacity of a resource. Using only one would give an incomplete picture of resource availability.

questions.stem: If a project manager is responsible for approving time sheets or submitting time cards on behalf of team members, they should be given what role?
questions.explanation: A project manager who needs to approve time sheets or submit time cards on behalf of team members should be given the timecard_admin role. This role grants permissions to manage, approve, and submit time cards for other users. The other options (approval_admin, form_admin, activity_admin) are not standard ServiceNow SPM roles for time management authorization.

questions.stem: What features are not included in a teamspace application but can be added in teamspace settings? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Idea and Demand Assessments are features not included in the default teamspace application but can be added through teamspace settings. Teamspaces provide customizable workspaces for project teams, with core features like project views and workbench configuration included by default. Idea management and Demand Assessment capabilities are optional add-ons that can be enabled when the team needs them.

questions.stem: What are the allocation types available under the Allocation Config tab on a resource plan? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The allocation types available under the Allocation Config tab on a resource plan are: Plan duration (allocate across the entire plan), Weekly (split allocation by week), and Monthly (split allocation by month). Daily and Yearly are not standard allocation type options in Resource Management.

questions.stem: Which users have access to the project administration application? (Choose two.)
A customer needs to know what activity type is associated to time entries in the project so that they can capitalize build tasks. What is the best method to do this?

options.text: Put all capital project tasks in one phase and report from those tasks.
Create a capital project task flag.
Leverage project time categories to classify the time.

questions.stem: Who can submit Ideas?
What role is required to view the Details tab of a project in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation: The it_project_user role is required to view the Details tab of a project in Project Workspace. This is the base user role for viewing project details. it_project_manager provides additional edit capabilities, it_project is not a standard role name, and it_project_workspace_user is not the correct role for this access.

questions.stem: Actuals on a resource plan are updated by what activity?
What must a resource plan contain if a resource plan is associated with a time card?
questions.explanation: A resource plan must contain hard allocation bookings to be associated with a time card. Hard allocations represent confirmed, committed resource assignments that time can be logged against. Soft allocations (planned but not confirmed) cannot be linked to time cards. Allocation spread types are unrelated to time card association.

questions.stem: You can forecast future costs of projects based on: (Choose two.)

options.text: Changes in project such as project requirements.

questions.stem: What is the formula used to calculate the risk rank for a risk?
When a demand is converted to a project, the following fields retain the start and due date: (Choose two.)
Which work artifacts can be used to define the scope of a release? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The work artifacts that can define the scope of a release include Defects, Enhancements, and Projects. These items are associated with a release to define what work is included. Portfolios exist at a higher organizational level and Demands are pre-project artifacts that are not typically included in release scope.

questions.stem: When creating a program, which of the following cannot be part of multiple programs? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A project and a demand cannot be part of multiple programs simultaneously. Each project can belong to only one program, and similarly a demand is associated with a single program. Tasks belong to projects (not directly to programs), and portfolios are a higher-level construct that can contain multiple programs.

questions.stem: When working with demands, which field must be set to "Yes" in order for a user to receive an assessment?
Which table stores daily capacity of a user?
Plugins may be added to the base platform in one of the following ways: (Choose three.)

options.text: Activated by default in the base ServiceNow system.
Activated by an admin (not by default).

questions.stem: How can users view data in Project Workspace on the Financials tab? (Choose two.)
Under the Preferences tab on the Demand form, you have the option to: (Choose two.)

options.text: Close a demand on creation of a project
Close a demand on closure of a project

questions.stem: Risks and issues submitted in which forms will be included in the Program record? (Choose three.)
Which of the following defines a parent-child relationship? (Choose two.)

options.text: A parent-child task must finish before another begins.
Parent-child task relationships do not have any effect on task time constraints.
Any number of child tasks can be nested under a parent task with or without any dependencies.
A parent-child relationship is not saved as a record in any table.

questions.explanation: Two characteristics of parent-child relationships in project management: parent-child task relationships do not affect task time constraints (B) — scheduling is controlled by dependencies, not hierarchy. Also, any number of child tasks can be nested under a parent task with or without dependencies (C). Parent-child is about organizational hierarchy, not scheduling constraints.

questions.stem: When a user's schedule changes, what action needs to be taken to update their existing data?

options.text: Update calendar manually to reflect the changed capacity

questions.explanation: When a user's schedule changes, you must update their capacity via the 'Update Resource Capacity' action. This recalculates the user's capacity based on the new schedule. Manual calendar updates, project plan changes, and doing nothing would all leave stale capacity data that does not reflect the schedule change.

questions.stem: If a resource plan is not associated manually to a time card, then a resource plan is auto-associated. The auto-association is done based on which of the following in the time card?
questions.explanation: When a resource plan is not manually associated to a time card, auto-association is based on the task field in the time card. The system matches the time card's task to existing resource plans to automatically create the association. Hard/soft allocation types and resource type are not the basis for auto-association.

questions.stem: Where is the normalization process used?
Which feature provides a central location for portfolio managers to create and track the roadmap for project and demand execution?

The Project Management application enables users to create parent-child relationships between tasks and dependencies, such as finish-to-start and finish-to-finish, between tasks. How many relationships can exist between two tasks?
Which field, referenced from the cost plan, determines if a cost plan is Capex or Орех?
Which table would an admin modify in order to add extra columns to the side panel or remove default column choices on the Prioritization page within the Portfolio Planning Workspace?
questions.explanation: The [sn_align_cmn_int_choice_map] table is used to add extra columns or remove default column choices on the Prioritization page within the Portfolio Planning Workspace. This table controls the column mapping between the integration data and what appears in the prioritization view's side panel.

questions.stem: Project score is calculated based on the individual scores of the following attributes: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Project score is calculated based on the individual scores of Value Score and Risk Score. These two dimensions evaluate a project's potential value against its risk level to determine the overall project score for portfolio prioritization. Alignment Score and Strategy Score are not part of the standard project score calculation.

questions.stem: Which is an example of an offset type on a monetary benefit plan?
questions.explanation: Start Date is an example of an offset type on a monetary benefit plan. The offset type determines when benefits begin relative to the plan — a Start Date offset means benefits begin from a specific date. Rate Card is for cost calculations, Risk is an assessment metric, and Cost is not an offset type.

questions.stem: A customer requires five (5) teamspaces to support different departments. What should you do?

options.text: Contact the Account Representative to activate the teamspaces.
Use UI Policies and Business Rules to enable teamspaces.

questions.explanation: To support five teamspaces for different departments, you need to activate each teamspace via its individual plugin. Each departmental teamspace has its own plugin that must be independently activated. There is no single property that enables all teamspaces, and UI Policies/Business Rules are not the mechanism for this configuration.

questions.stem: The overall health of a program rolls up from the latest status report of each project in the program. The status is indicated by which colors? (Choose three.)
Which role allows you to allocate a resource?
Which roles can add stakeholders to a Portfolio? (Choose two.)
Which role in Project Portfolio Management contains both the resource_user and it_demand manager roles?
During the allocation process, when named resources are allocated to a plan, where is resource cost derived from?

options.text: Labor rate card for the user
Cost specified on the resource allocation
Labor rate card for the fiscal period

questions.stem: Which of the following is the default schedule for the Project Management application?

options.text: Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday. Includes the child schedule U.S. Holidays.
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 8:00am to noon and 1:00-5:00pm.
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 9:00am to 5:00pm.
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday.

questions.explanation: The default schedule for the Project Management application repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 8:00am to noon and 1:00-5:00pm. This 8-hour workday with a lunch break is the standard schedule used for project task scheduling and resource calculations. The two schedule entries cover morning (8:00-12:00) and afternoon (13:00-17:00).

questions.stem: Which role should be given to users such as portfolio or product managers, so they can create, update, and delete, portfolio plans?
questions.explanation: The Portfolio Planning user role [sn_align_core.apw_user] should be given to users such as portfolio or product managers so they can create, update, and delete portfolio plans. The admin role (apw_admin) provides more access than needed for plan management. Milestones roles are for milestone functionality, not portfolio planning.

questions.stem: Which role can create a project status report in the Project Workspace?
As an it_pps_admin, what can you use to detect corrupt data in a project, such as tasks with invalid parents or cyclic relations in a project?
What are some basics of Demand Management? (Choose two.)

options.text: Use the Project Workspace to compare and assess demands

questions.explanation: The basics of Demand Management include creating stakeholders and submitting ideas. The setup phase involves creating stakeholders and assessment categories, while the process begins with assessing submitted ideas before promoting them to demands. Using Project Workspace is incorrect — the Demand Workbench (not Project Workspace) is used for comparing demands.

questions.stem: In the default system, when working with demands, what two assessment metrics are supported when taking an assessment survey? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The default system supports two assessment metrics for demands: Risk and Strategic Alignment. When stakeholders take an assessment survey for a demand, they evaluate the demand against these two dimensions. Cost and Size are demand attributes but not default assessment survey metrics.

questions.stem: On a resource plan, when the attribute for "Derive assignee list from resource plan" is set to true, in what state must the plan be to allow a resource to be added to the assignee field?
What is the formula for Forecasted Utilization?
questions.explanation: Forecasted Utilization is calculated as (Allocated Hours + Confirmed Hours) / Capacity. This represents the total expected resource utilization including both planned allocations (soft bookings) and confirmed allocations (hard bookings). Committed Utilization uses only Allocated Hours / Capacity, while Confirmed Utilization uses only Confirmed Hours / Capacity.

questions.stem: Instead of starting from scratch, what can project managers make use of to rapidly build their project plan?
Resource plan costs are divided into: (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Resource plan costs are divided into three categories: Planned Cost (estimated/budgeted costs), Actual Cost (costs incurred from actual resource work), and Forecast Cost (projected costs combining planned and actual data). Allocated Cost and Expense Cost are not standard resource plan cost divisions.

questions.stem: Why is it recommended to keep the value of the property 'com.snc.project.task.max_task_duration' to 2600 or under?

options.text: Best practices states projects should be no longer than 5 years.
Because projects longer than 2600 days will no longer load.
The system is unable to handle more than 2600 tasks.

questions.stem: What UI Actions are available to link RIDAC records? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The two UI Actions available to link RIDAC records are Associate RIDAC (to associate an existing RIDAC record with a project or demand) and Convert to RIDAC (to convert an existing record into a RIDAC item). Apply Template and Save as New Template are template-related actions, and View RIDAC is a navigation action, not a linking action.

questions.stem: Each teamspace has its own: (Choose two.)
What is the default offset duration used to automatically calculate the red/yellow/green task status?
Which system property needs to be set to True to be able to allocate budgets in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation: The sn_invst_pln.enable_budget_allocation_v2 property must be set to True to enable budget allocation in Project Workspace. This property activates the budget allocation functionality. The other properties handle default expense types, budget allocation attributes, and project cost rollups respectively.

questions.stem: How can the latest financial forecasts (actuals or planned costs) be compared to initial planned costs month over month in the new Project Workspace?

options.text: Using the Cost plan breakdown form

questions.explanation: In the new Project Workspace, the Financials Cost page allows you to compare the latest financial forecasts (actuals or planned costs) to initial planned costs month over month. This page provides cost breakdowns by fiscal period with the ability to see variances. Cost plan breakdown forms are for individual records, and Compare Baselines is for schedule baselines.

questions.stem: At which point in the Demand Management lifecycle do assessments get sent to stakeholders?
questions.explanation: In the Demand Management lifecycle, assessments are sent to stakeholders during the Screening phase. When a demand enters the Screening state, the system triggers assessment surveys to stakeholders for evaluation. This happens before the demand is qualified or approved. Creation and Planning stages do not trigger assessments.

questions.stem: What are the available resource states in the Resource status field on the New Resource Assignment form? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: The four available resource states in the Resource status field on the New Resource Assignment form are: Unassigned (for attribute-based requests awaiting assignment), Pending (for user/group assignments awaiting approval), Approved (assignment approved by resource manager), and Unapproved (assignment rejected). Cancelled, In Progress, and Open are not resource assignment states.

questions.stem: What can be used to derive date-effective, criteria-driven hourly rates for calculating planned and actual resource costs for a project or demand?
questions.explanation: A rate model is used to derive date-effective, criteria-driven hourly rates for calculating planned and actual resource costs for a project or demand. Rate models define how labor costs are calculated based on criteria such as role, location, and skill level with effective dates. Time cards record hours, and resource assignments link resources to work.

questions.stem: What determines the resource schedule if the Schedules related list and Schedule field are both empty?

options.text: Average Daily FTE Hours/Hours Per Person Day (com.snc.resource_management.average_daily_fte) property

questions.explanation: If both the Schedules related list and Schedule field are empty, the schedule specified in the Default Schedule Name (com.snc.resource_management.default_schedule) property determines the resource schedule. The system checks: 1) Schedules related list, 2) Schedule field, 3) default property. The base system uses 'Resource Management Schedule' as the default.

questions.stem: Which field must be populated to request a person with a specific role when creating a resource assignment?
questions.explanation: The Role field must be populated to request a person with a specific role when creating a resource assignment. This allows the system to find and assign resources who match the requested role. Skill, Group, and Resource fields serve different purposes — Role specifically filters by the role attribute for attribute-based assignments.

questions.stem: What plugin must be installed to use Capacity Planning in a portfolio?
questions.explanation: The Portfolio Planning plugin must be installed to use Capacity Planning in a portfolio. Capacity Planning is a feature within the Portfolio Planning Workspace that helps portfolio managers understand resource capacity across their portfolio. Collaborative Work Management, Skills Management, and Time Card Management serve different functions.

questions.stem: What are the characteristics of the default Resource Management schedule? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The default Resource Management schedule has three characteristics: Monday through Friday 13:00-17:00, Weekly on Weekdays, and Monday through Friday 08:00-12:00. These two time blocks (morning and afternoon with lunch break) repeat every weekday. It does not include Saturday or the '8-5 excluding holidays' summary.

questions.stem: What role must be assigned to users to be considered for resource planning?
questions.explanation: The pps_resource role must be assigned to users to be considered for resource planning. This role identifies a user as a resource available for assignment in the PPM/SPM resource management system. Without this role, users will not appear in resource selection lists. The other roles serve different functions in the platform.

questions.stem: What provides a centralized view of the resource allocations and resource requests?
questions.explanation: The Resource Management Workspace provides a centralized view of resource allocations and resource requests. It is a dedicated workspace for resource managers to view unassigned tasks, heatmap views of resource bandwidth, and manage priority resource assignment requests. Project Management Workspace focuses on projects, not resource management.

questions.stem: Which role does a group need for selection in a resource assignment?
questions.explanation: A group needs the pps_resource role to be available for selection in a resource assignment. This role marks the group as a resource entity within the PPM resource management system. Without this role, the group will not appear in the resource assignment group selection dropdown.

questions.stem: What role can create or modify a rate model?
questions.explanation: The it_pps_admin role can create or modify a rate model. Rate models are administrative configurations that define how labor costs are calculated, so they require the PPM administration role. Time card admin, push admin, and release admin roles do not have rate model management capabilities.

questions.stem: At a minimum, which role is required to update a project task in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation: The it_project_user role is the minimum role required to update a project task in Project Workspace. This base role allows users to view and update tasks assigned to them or their projects. it_project_manager provides broader project management capabilities beyond simple task updates.

questions.stem: Which of these items should implementers create/configure first during an SPM implementation?
questions.explanation: Implementers should create/configure Business Units first during an SPM implementation. Business units form the organizational foundation that portfolios, demands, and projects are organized around. Demand management, dashboards, and lenses all depend on having the business unit structure in place first.

questions.stem: Which colors are used as indicators of project health in a project status report? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The standard traffic-light colors used as indicators of project health in a project status report are: Green (on track), Yellow (at risk), and Red (off track). These three colors provide a quick visual assessment of project health. Orange and Blue are not used in the default project health indicators.

questions.stem: Which role provides edit access so users can generate capacity planning in Portfolio Planning Workspace?
questions.explanation: The sn_align_ws.spw_capacity_user role provides edit access for generating capacity planning in the Portfolio Planning Workspace. The capacity_read role only provides view access, the financial_user role is for financial planning, and the ap_read_only role provides read-only access to the workspace.

questions.stem: When creating a planning item, which fields are populated automatically with the Approved start date value and the Approved end date value respectively? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: When creating a planning item, the Planned start date is automatically populated with the Approved start date value, and the Planned end date is populated with the Approved end date value. Actual start date is populated when work begins, and Due date is a separate field not auto-populated from approved dates.

questions.stem: Which resource tasks can be completed in Project Workspace? (Choose two.)

options.text: Allocate a resource creating a named-resource assignment
Request a resource using role, group, or skill

questions.explanation: In Project Workspace, two resource tasks can be completed: allocating a resource by creating a named-resource assignment (specifying a specific person) and requesting a resource using role, group, or skill (attribute-based assignment). Creating resource calendars, viewing requests, and viewing capacity are Resource Management Workspace functions.

questions.stem: Which personas can request an attribute-based resource assignment? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Demand managers and project managers can request attribute-based resource assignments. Demand managers request resources for their demands, while project managers request resources for their projects. Both can specify attributes like role, skill, or group when creating assignments. Idea managers and business stakeholders do not directly request resources.

questions.stem: Which options are available in the ‘Effort type’ field on the Resource Assignments form, when requesting resources? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The Effort type field on the Resource Assignments form has three options: Person days (request by number of days), Hours (request by hourly basis), and FTE/Full Time Equivalent (request by FTE units, where 1 FTE = 8 hours by default). Group is an assignment type, and 'Weekly on weekdays' is a schedule type, not effort type.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow application interacts with SPM through risk assessments?
questions.explanation: Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC) interacts with SPM through risk assessments. GRC provides the risk assessment framework that SPM leverages for evaluating project, demand, and portfolio risks. Field Service Management, DevOps, and IT Service Management do not directly integrate with SPM through risk assessments.

questions.stem: What is used to generate labor cost if a project or demand does not have an associated rate model?
questions.explanation: When a project or demand does not have an associated rate model, the default labor rate is used to generate labor costs. This system-level default rate acts as a fallback for cost calculations. The default RM schedule determines working hours, not labor rates. Project plans and time cards track work but do not define rates.

questions.stem: Where can a project manager go to view quick reports of time card exceptions, and category wise time reported for their projects?
questions.explanation: A project manager can view quick reports of time card exceptions and category-wise time reported for their projects through Analytics Time sheet. This view provides time card analysis including exceptions, category breakdowns, and time reporting summaries. The PMO dashboard provides broader project metrics, not time-card-specific analytics.

questions.stem: How can cost plans be generated from resource assignments? (Choose two.)

options.text: Select the ‘Generate labor costs’ button on Project Workspace
Update the appropriate Resource Management property
Run a scheduled job to automatically generate labor costs from resource assignments
Select the ‘Generate cost’ button in Resource Management Workspace

questions.explanation: Cost plans can be generated from resource assignments in two ways: selecting the 'Generate labor costs' button on Project Workspace (manual generation) and running a scheduled job to automatically generate labor costs from resource assignments. The Resource Management Workspace 'Generate cost' button and updating RM properties are not the mechanisms for this.

questions.stem: Where can custom risk ranks and value scores (such as High-Medium, Medium-Low, or Absolute-Low) be configured to evaluate the impact and probability of a risk?
questions.explanation: The Risk Value Lookup module is used to configure custom risk ranks and value scores such as High-Medium, Medium-Low, or Absolute-Low. This module provides a lookup table for defining how risk probability and impact combinations translate to specific risk ranks. The Risk form shows individual risks, and normalized values are calculated differently.

questions.stem: What needs to be configured if a customer wants to change the attributes copied when using copy project or copy partial project?
Which options can budget be allocated by, when setting the 'sn_invst_pln.budget_allocation_attribute' property? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: When setting the sn_invst_pln.budget_allocation_attribute property, budget can be allocated by Cost type and Expense type. These two attributes define how budget allocation is categorized. Budget cost is not an allocation attribute, and Employee type is used for resource classification, not budget allocation.

questions.stem: Demand managers can enhance a demand request by adding the following: (Choose three.)
Which roles can create rate models? (Choose two.)
Where can resource assignments be created? (Choose two.)
What does the color red indicate on the Allocation heatmap?
To use the Time Sheet dashboard, what plugin must be installed?

options.text: Common ITSM Service Portal Application Components (com.snc.app_common.service_portal)
Performance Analytics - Content Pack - PPM Standard plugin (com.snc.pa.pmo_dashboards)

questions.stem: Where can a user export project data in Excel, CSV, PPT, MS Project (MPP), or XML file formats?
What must be populated for a resource to be considered for capacity planning?
What is the process called for allocating a resource or group of resources to a project task?
Which field on the Idea Module form displays the unique identifier for the module, that is used as a parameter in the Idea Portal URL to direct users?
questions.explanation: The Module ID field on the Idea Module form displays the unique identifier used as a parameter in the Idea Portal URL to direct users. For example, if Module ID is 'hr', the portal URL would be /idea/?id=ideas_list&sysparm_module_id=hr. Idea Table stores the table reference, Module Name is the display name, and Category Limit sets max categories.

questions.stem: A project expense line is a cost associated with a specific source. Examples of specific sources could include: (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Project expense lines can be associated with specific sources including Configuration Item (CI), User (labor costs), and Fixed Asset (physical asset costs). These represent the entities that generate costs within a project. Demand and Project are organizational entities rather than sources of specific expense lines.

questions.stem: Which out of the box planning attributes are enabled by default, for attribute-based resource mapping?
What happens to the expense line after it is processed?

options.text: The actual cost is recorded at the portfolio level

questions.stem: The Program Management application provides the following capabilities to the program manager: (Choose three.)

options.text: Create tasks specific to the program.
Create a program by adding related projects and demands.
Manage ideas specific to the program.

questions.stem: How can project managers be restricted from creating resource assignments with named resources?

options.text: Create an Access Control List (ACL) rule
Create a reference qualifier on the 'assigned to' field
The system automatically does this and can only be disabled by an admin

questions.explanation: Project managers can be restricted from creating resource assignments with named resources by creating a reference qualifier on the 'assigned to' field. This controls which resources appear in the field's dropdown, effectively preventing direct named-resource selection. ACLs and business rules are more complex approaches, and this is not an automatic system behavior.

questions.stem: What action can a resource manager take to help monitor projects and work items?

options.text: Create resource cards filtered by work type

questions.stem: When entering time worked into a time sheet, which feature is recommended to group different types of work (e.g., standard hours and overtime)?
What is the default schedule for a project?
What can be created to update the display limit of roadmap items shown on the Roadmap view of the Portfolio Planning Workspace?
What does an admin need to configure to ensure that departments without any planning items are visible when switching to the Prioritization Hierarchy view?

options.text: Create the 'sn_align_ws.gantt_show_higher_planning_upper_entities' system property and set it to false
Create the 'sn_align_ws.gantt_hide_empty_entities' system property and set It to true
Create the 'sn_align ws,gantt_hide_empty_entities' system property and set it to false
Create the 'sn_align_ws.gantt_show_higher_planning_upper_entities' system property and set it to true

questions.stem: What status must a resource assignment be in to be split?
Which of the following states appear in the process flow indicator at the top of the Demand form by default? (Choose three.)
Which capability allows users to view variances in a project's schedule?

What offers step-by-step delivery guidance based on real world experiences and proven leading practices, to perform digital transformations relying on the expertise of thousands of successful implementations?
Which ServiceNow application interacts with SPM through customer projects?
Which of the following tasks can be performed when Innovation Management is integrated with Universal Request? (Choose two.)

options.text: Create a project from a universal request
Create an idea from a universal request
Transfer an idea to another department
Send a universal request to a demand manager for review

questions.explanation: When Innovation Management is integrated with Universal Request, you can create an idea from a universal request and send a universal request to a demand manager for review. This integration bridges the service request channel with the innovation pipeline. Creating projects from requests and transferring ideas between departments are separate functions.

questions.stem: An it_project_manager can request resources by which of the following: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: An it_project_manager can request resources by Person Days and Hours. These are two of the three effort types available on the resource assignment form (the third being FTE). Month and Day are not valid effort type options for requesting resources in the resource management system.

questions.stem: Which role is required to configure the default columns on the Planning page of Project Workspace?
What system role is needed to manage programs?
questions.explanation: The it_program_manager role is needed to manage programs in ServiceNow. This role provides the capabilities to create, edit, and manage programs and their associated projects and demands. it_project_manager manages projects, it_portfolio_manager_admin manages portfolios, and it_program_manager_admin is not a standard role.

questions.stem: In order for a business unit to have its own Idea Portal to retrieve data, what must be configured first?

options.text: A business unit cannot have its own Idea Portal

questions.explanation: An Idea module must be configured first for a business unit to have its own Idea Portal. The Idea module form defines the Module ID used as a URL parameter to direct users to the department-specific portal. Each business unit creates its own module with a unique Module ID. Categories and portal URLs are configured within the module.

questions.stem: Which formats can data be exported to from the Resource Management Workspace? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Data from the Resource Management Workspace can be exported in CSV and Excel formats. These are the standard export formats available in ServiceNow workspaces. JPEG and PPT are presentation/image formats that are not supported as data export options from the workspace.

questions.stem: Which conditions must be met in order to change the planned start date of a project? (Choose two.)

options.text: project_funding records are selected for execution
Project actual dates are not populated
The state of a project is Pending or Open
The state of the project is Closed Skipped

questions.explanation: Two conditions must be met to change the planned start date of a project: project actual dates must not be populated (no actual work started) and the project state must be Pending or Open. If actuals exist or the project is in a later state like WIP or Closed, the planned dates are locked from changes.

questions.stem: What actions can a project manager perform related to Agile projects on the Details page of Project Workspace? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: On the Details page of Project Workspace for Agile projects, a project manager can view widgets and reports, add stories, and view the WBS (Work Breakdown Structure). The Details page provides a comprehensive view of the project's work items and status. Creating Agile phases, creating Doc pages, and removing epics are not standard Details page actions.

questions.stem: Which feature allows users to create scenarios in a simulated environment and adjust the prioritization and timelines of planning items?
Which feature in Resource Management Workspace provides a breakdown view of the assigned work and efforts?
What role can configure an idea module, map idea categories to the Idea module, and add navigation for the Idea Portal?
Which tasks can users with the Business stakeholder [business_stakeholder] role perform? (Choose three.)

options.text: Can view generated resource capacity for planning items in the Capacity Planning screen.
Can access all the modules in the Portfolio Planning application.
Add notes or comments to roadmaps that are shared with them.
View portfolio plans, free-form roadmaps, and attachments added to the roadmaps.

questions.stem: Which status is a resource assignment created in if the assignment is for a user or group?
questions.explanation: If the resource assignment is for a user or group, the assignment is created in the Pending state. This means it awaits approval from the resource manager before the resource is confirmed. Attribute-based assignments (by role, skill, or group) are created in the Unassigned state instead. Approved status comes after resource manager confirmation.

questions.stem: How can a resource manager easily move a task from one resource to another? (Choose two.)

options.text: Use the Split resource assignments feature
Drag and drop the resource assignment from one resource to a different resource
Select 'Reassign' from the row context menu on the work item

questions.stem: What are the default project template configuration records available in the Template Config module? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The default project template configuration records in the Template Config module are: Project (for project-level configurations), Project template (for template definitions), and Project task (for task-level configurations). Task, Program task, Project subtask, and Portfolio task are not default template configuration records.

questions.stem: The PPM Standard plugin enables an it_project_manager to perform the following activities: (Choose three.)

options.text: Track actual amount spent compared to an approved budget.
Establish resource requirements and track costs.

questions.explanation: The PPM Standard plugin enables an it_project_manager to: track actual amount spent compared to an approved budget (A), determine overall project cost requirements (C), and establish resource requirements and track costs (E). Configuring cost type definitions is an admin function, and defining portfolio targets is a portfolio manager responsibility.

questions.stem: Where can an admin configure the colors and quadrant labels on the Demand Workbench?
When a time card is approved, the actual time is stored in which two tables? (Choose two.)

options.text: Resource Aggregate tables (Daily, Weekly and Monthly)

questions.stem: What artifacts can be created from a demand? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: From a demand, you can create three types of artifacts: Change (change request), Project (the most common promotion path), and Defect (for defect tracking). The Demand Management docs confirm demands can be promoted to projects, enhancements, changes, or defects. Resources and Tasks are not artifacts created directly from demands.

questions.stem: If you want the project planned start date to remain the same despite the start date of the earliest task, what property would you disable?

options.text: Roll up project start date from tasks [com.snc.project.rollup_prroject_start_date],
Retain start on constraint on tasks after adding relations [com.snc.project.allow_start_on_relations].
Max duration allowed for a project/project task [com.snc.project.task.max_task_duration].
Max date span into future or past from the current date for the project/project task [com.snc.project.task.check_date_span_years].

questions.stem: What can be created for a group to schedule necessary meetings, training, time off. etc., and to reflect a reduced capacity in the Capacity Planning tab of the Portfolio Planning Workspace?
Which users have access to the Project Administration module? (Choose two.)
